rules.explanation: The package is created from a wildcard build tree rather than an explicit product allowlist.
rules.recommendation: Assemble a clean staging directory from named product files before compression.

rules.explanation: A host dependency tool is copied into the product staging tree.
rules.recommendation: Keep host build tools outside the release allowlist and scan only final product contents.

rules.explanation: Redistributable runtime DLLs are copied by directory glob; the ARM64 CRT redist folder ships at least one x64 image (vcruntime140_1.dll), so a glob copy poisons an otherwise pure package.
rules.recommendation: Filter every redistributable by its PE machine value, assert that the required runtime DLLs survived the filter, and record accepted and rejected files in a manifest so the omission is auditable.

rules.explanation: The archive is re-expanded and inspected but no binary is executed from the expanded tree and the expanded path is never surfaced to a caller, so no downstream gate can detect a missing runtime dependency or a missing required directory.
rules.recommendation: Run an end-to-end invocation against the re-expanded package in addition to the build output; a PE purity scan proves architecture, never runnability.

rules.explanation: A directory required at runtime is created in the staging tree but never receives a file, and a ZIP archive cannot store an empty directory, so it disappears from the shipped package.
rules.recommendation: Write a placeholder file into every runtime-required directory so it survives compression, and cover it with an end-to-end run of the re-expanded package.
